documentation.title: Type Casts
documentation.standard: The float cast must be used instead of the double and real casts. The real cast was deprecated in PHP 7.4 and removed in PHP 8.0. The double cast was deprecated in PHP 8.5.

code.title: Valid: Using the normalized float cast.

documentation.standard: The unset cast must not be used. It was deprecated in PHP 7.2 and removed in PHP 8.0. Use unset() to unset a variable instead.

code.title: Valid: Using the unset() language construct.

documentation.standard: Using the binary cast or the b prefix is discouraged. The binary cast was deprecated in PHP 8.5. Use the string cast or a regular string literal instead.

code.title: Valid: Using the string cast and a string literal.
Invalid: Using the binary cast and the b prefix.
